lines.text: ok roger let's go check on the farm
Okay big brother! Lead the way, I'm right behind you
Okay, we need wood first. See that oak tree over there?
I see it! Can I punch the first block? I want to try.
Go for it. Just hold the button down.
It's cracking... it's cracking... oh! It popped out! That's so satisfying.
sorry, my dog pepper is barking at the door, one sec
aww pepper! take your time big brother, i'll wait here
Nice. Grab a few more logs and we can make planks.
Okay. I'll get the ones near the bottom so we don't leave floating leaves everywhere.
Eh, floating leaves are basically tradition at this point.
Really? Then I'll leave a little one. For tradition.
ugh a zombie got into the farm and trampled half the wheat
oh no, the wheat! i'm going after it
Planks done. Now a crafting table.
Four planks in a square, right? I think I remember that one.
Exactly right.
Oh! I got it right! Okay, placing it here, next to this flower.
oh hey a village. and there's a cat, i'm calling it noodle
noodle! that's a good name for a cat, big brother
Now some wooden pickaxes so we can mine stone.
Wooden ones first. They look kind of fragile, though.
They are. They just need to get us to stone.
Then they have a very important job. Little brave pickaxes.
next time we're building a fence around the whole farm so this never happens again
a fence sounds good! i can gather the wood for the posts, big brother
There's gray stone showing on that hillside.
I see it. Should we walk around, or go straight over the hill?
Straight over. Watch this jump.
Wait, there's a gap right th... oh no. You went straight into it.
That was totally on purpose.
That was a very confident jump into absolutely nothing.
Okay, okay. Help me out of this hole.
I'll dig a little step for you. There! Now you can hop up.
ok gotta go, bye roger
Okay, bye big brother! Thanks for the help with the hole, I'll keep the wood safe for the fence.

remembers: Alex and I wanted a fence around the farm after a zombie trampled the wheat. Alex laughed at my hole-digging step, and I like being useful to them.
